'''Target-rings''' were sporting equipment used in the [[trophy chase]], a sport played on [[Dalos IV]]. They were suspended from stable [[neph]]s, and players attempted to guide an [[anti-grav ball]] through them using [[repulsor-stick]]s.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
